decisions.reason: The firm's heavy public commitment and flagship status, including the home-page launch event, make escalation pressure strong enough to keep it despite its distance from the core.
Building on the established offer supports continued investment, but without flagship status or quantified results, escalation is moderate, leaving some chance of withdrawal.
As a close-to-core flagship with a quantified launch on the home page, it has high sunk costs and public commitment, making dropping very unlikely.
Close to the established offer but not publicly showcased as a focus, it has moderate escalation support, so keep is likely unless results clearly disappoint.
The quantified positive customer result and close fit with existing offerings reinforce escalation of commitment, making discontinuation highly unlikely.
